summary_en: SAME is a self-supervised restoration framework for single-channel sonar images corrupted by spatially correlated multiplicative speckle. Its multi-scale mixture-of-experts module adaptively selects receptive fields to separate noise from structure, while a frozen DINO backbone supplies category-agnostic structural priors to recover details lost through blind-spot masking. Experiments on DEBRIS and KLSG report stronger speckle suppression and structural fidelity without requiring clean reference images.

summary_en: This work proposes a sparse-Bayesian wideband acoustic-imaging method for small-aperture microphone arrays. A hierarchical conjugate-prior model shares sparsity parameters across frequency bands, enabling joint use of wideband observations and closed-form variational-Bayes updates. Simulated and measured experiments show improved source-map resolution and lower false detections compared with conventional beamforming and MUSIC, although the iterative matrix operations increase computational cost.
